context: A boss and his manager read morning crime headlines
purpose: Teach: 殺害/銃/爆弾/解雇/死者/探偵/悲劇/単独

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おい、今朝の新聞見たか。銃を使った殺害事件がまた起きたらしいぞ。
lines.en: Hey, did you see this morning's paper? Another shooting murder case has happened.
lines.style: Gruff boss voice, lowered and serious, paper rustling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、読みました。死者は三名で、犯人は単独犯だと書いてありましたね。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. Three dead, and the article said the perpetrator was a lone criminal.
lines.style: Respectful manager tone, measured and slightly tense, factual delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それに駅前で爆弾が見つかった件、未だに容疑者が捕まっていないそうじゃないか。
lines.en: And that bomb found near the station, apparently they still haven't caught the suspect.
lines.style: Frustrated grumble, shaking head, coffee cup clinking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察も困っているようで、私立探偵まで動員されたとかいう噂を聞きました。
lines.en: The police seem stuck, and I heard rumors a private detective was even called in.
lines.style: Hushed informative tone, leaning in confidentially.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: あぁ、本当に悲劇だな。被害者の家族のことを思うと胸が痛むよ。
lines.en: Ah, what a tragedy. My heart aches when I think of the victims' families.
lines.style: Heavy sigh, voice softening with genuine sympathy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ところで社長、犯人は不当解雇を理由に恨みを抱いていた可能性があるとか。
lines.en: By the way sir, apparently the suspect may have held a grudge over unfair dismissal.
lines.style: Cautious analytical tone, glancing up from the newspaper carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほどな。一見普通の社員でも、追い詰められれば何をするか分からん時代だ。
lines.en: I see. Even seemingly ordinary employees can do anything when pushed to the edge.
lines.style: Philosophical drawl, slow nod, troubled expression deepening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 我が社も社員のケアには気をつけないと、しょうがない事では済まされませんね。
lines.en: Our company must take better care of employees, otherwise we can't dismiss it lightly.
lines.style: Concerned earnest tone, folding the newspaper deliberately.
